answer: To create a fake identity, the attacker must buy a unique knoll land survey record from a geospatial agency, paying $200 and waiting 10 days per identity. The attacker pays $200 and 10 days. This cannot be cheaply bypassed: the cheapest cheat is to bribe the surveyor, risking $5,000 fine and 90 days in jail. Each knoll land survey record is genuinely scarce and non-duplicable, backing exactly one identity, and duplicates are rejected on check. The aggregate cost of 100 fake identities is $20,000 and 1,000 days. Mirror the real-world scarcity; the delta in cost deters Sybil attacks.
